title.fr: Mouvement d'une particule chargée dans un champ électrique uniforme

formula: a = q·E/m ;  y = ½·(q·E/m)·(x/v₀)²   (parabole de déviation)
sketch:
Observe: SVG scene of two parallel plates ±U, uniform E between; a
charged particle enters horizontally with v₀. Student sets q, m, U,
v₀; trajectory is a parabola (analog of projectile with a = qE/m).
HUD reads déviation Y at exit. Experiment: 3 seeded exit-Y targets
(oscilloscope-like); student tunes U so particle exits at target Y.
Evaluate: trajectory hidden; only plates and target Y-marker on far
screen shown; student submits U blind. Wrinkle: sign of q flips
deflection direction; sign in HUD.
